mapper.sql: id, project_id, library_type, source_task_id, filename, content_type, size_bytes, content_hash, storage_path, created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO file_library_document (project_id, library_type, source_task_id, filename, content_type, size_bytes, content_hash, storage_path, created_at) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{libraryType}, #{sourceTaskId}, #{filename}, #{contentType}, #{sizeBytes}, #{contentHash}, #{storagePath}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM file_library_document WHERE project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
